svg.title: SAI — the GitHub singularity
svg.desc: An animated GitHub profile collapses into a central singularity: real project cards and a giant SAI headline shred into fragments, then orbit with words from my work in kernels, CUDA, model revision, GPU serving, and open source.

g.text: I build things to understand them.
GPU kernels · small models · ML runtimes
THE WORK DIDN'T DISAPPEAR. IT CHANGED ORBIT.
